description: The ancestral group or ethnicity of the participants. Keywords: Ancestry, Race, Ethnic. Examples: European (EUR), African American (AA), East Asian (EAS), Caribbean Hispanic.
The specific study or database name. Keywords: Study, Dataset, Discovery. Examples: ADNI, IGAP, UK Biobank, ADGC, CHARGE, EADI.

Study phase indicating whether results come from discovery, replication, meta-analysis, or combined analysis. Keywords: Stage, Phase, Discovery, Replication, Meta, Combined. Examples: Discovery, Replication, Stage 1, Stage 2, Meta-analysis, Joint analysis.
The reference panel or method used to infer unobserved genotypes. Keywords: Imputation, Reference panel, Phasing. Examples: 1000 Genomes (1000G), Haplotype Reference Consortium (HRC), TOPMed, UK10K.

Type of genetic data or study design used to generate the results. Keywords: Study type, Genotyping, Sequencing. Examples: GWAS, Whole Exome Sequencing (WES), Whole Genome Sequencing (WGS), Array genotyping.
The specific trait, disease, or outcome being analyzed. Keywords: Trait, Disease, Outcome. Examples: Alzheimer’s disease, BMI, LDL cholesterol, Type 2 diabetes, Blood pressure.
